g.title: j2357189232
g.text: Well, it depends on if it's the big ship or the little ship - but they both tap into the Void to cross the big distances. They cross through the Void.

g.title: j3370668088
g.text: Well, that's my Railjack. It has a replica of the severed finger of the Indifference - known as the Reliquary Drive - in it.

g.title: j2879985289
g.text: The big ship, the Railjack, uses a thing called a Reliquary Drive - it has a replica of the severed finger of the Indifference in it.

g.title: j4129813401
g.text: It uses that to tap into the Void to cross the big distances between the planets. It goes through the Void.

g.title: j2102761691
g.text: RL;CBA: Albrecht went into the Void, panicked, wound up stealing some of the Indifference's fingers.

g.title: j253055798
g.text: Well. Okay. So. Albrecht... was the first person to "discover" how to get into the Void.

g.title: j762417692
g.text: first... RL;CBA:?

g.title: j1053375767
g.text: It was a diving bell, of sorts. Made of something called seriglass. He stretched open the membrane between the worlds.

g.title: j2463589016
g.text: Real Long; Can't Be Arsed. Quincy taught it to me.

g.title: j1245751715
g.text: Things went... wrong, to put it lightly. He panicked, staggered, the thing tipped, it got knocked against the razor-sharp edge of the membrane.

g.title: j2765431571
g.text: huh...

g.title: j2128726517
g.text: The seriglass bell shattered and he fell into the Void.

g.title: j1231806794
g.text: second

g.title: j1271435377
g.text: And when he came to, he was back in his lab, only it wasn't his lab. And he was staring at himself. Only it wasn't himself. And "he" called himself a name only his mother would know.

g.title: j455773002
g.text: ****U HAVE ITS FINGERS?!?!?!****

g.title: j2488253738
g.text: So, Albrecht ran for his life. He cut himself up on the broken seriglass, and wrote in his own blood for his daughter to close the membrane behind him -

g.title: j33193911
g.text: AND U USE IT TO POWER YOUR RAILJACK?!?!

g.title: j2579433489
g.text: - because he could feel that the "man" was reaching for him.

g.title: j1689719553
g.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

g.title: j3923633251
g.text: She did. And when it shut? Well... its fingers were cut off, lying on the floor.

g.title: j4292404570
g.text: maybe that's y it's mad!!!

g.text: It powers a lot more than just the Railjack, that's the problem...

g.text: But unfortunately, the damage is done. Albrecht took the fingers. And now there's no going back.

g.text: There's something about the "Strands of Khra." It's super complicated? Something about it... I don't know?

g.title: j1680900722
g.text: I don't know if giving them back would do any good. I don't think it'd change his mind.

g.text: Binding it here? Keeping it on our playing field? We have its fingers, so its stuck playing by our rules.

g.text: .... i don't like any of this
